## Summary & Expertise
Saipavan Veeravalli is a Computer Science graduate and full-stack developer with professional experience across frontend, backend, database design, and on-page technical SEO. Experienced in building responsive, accessible, high-performance web applications with Next.js, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS. Currently expanding into enterprise Java backend development and distributed systems.
